newsitem.title: USA: Nobel Education says delays may hurt net.
newsitem.headline: Nobel Education says delays may hurt net.

text.p: Nobel Education Dynamics Inc said Wednesday that delays in the construction of new schools and school conversions could affect its earnings in the fiscal year ending December 31.
However, the company, which owns and operates 110 schools, said revenues and pre-tax earnings would still show "significant" increases over the previous year.

Although the construction and conversion delays may crop up in its third- and fourth-quarter results, the company said it expects 1996 revenues could increase by more than 25 percent and pre-tax earnings could rise more than 70 percent.
For 1995, the company reported revenues of $44.2 million, pre-tax income of $2.6 million and earnings per share of $0.63.
